test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

Why does homework have to be done daily?

options.text: Why are we doing homework daily?
Why do we have to do homework daily?
Why did we do homework daily?
Why should we do homework daily?

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Why do we have to do homework daily?'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is interrogative and in Present Perfect Tense, Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Perfect Tense, Passive Voice from Passive voice to Active voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: Why + do/does + Subject + have + to + V1 + Object​ (Active Voice)__ 
 
 

 Why + does/do + Object + have to be + V3 + by Subject​ __(Passive Voice)__

__
 
• Example: *Why do we have to do the tasks?** *(Active Voice)

 * * *Why do the tasks have to be done by us? *(Passive Voice)​

 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'Why do we have to do homework daily?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *He reads a novel. *(Active Voice)*​*
 
 

* A novel is read by him. *(Passive Voice)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Present Perfect Tense, Passive Voice में है।
 
• Present Perfect Tense, Passive Voice को Passive voice से Active voice में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• Object और Subject को एक दूसरे के साथ बदलें, यानी Active Voice का object, Passive Voice का subject बन जाती है।
 
• Structure: Why + do + Subject + have + to + V1 + Object​ (Active Voice)__ 
 
 

 Why + do + Object + have to be + V3 + by Subject​ (Passive Voice)​
